explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/899: if A ⊆ ℕ is infinite with |A ∩ [1,N]| = o(N), is limsup |(A-A) ∩ [1,N]|/|A ∩ [1,N]| = ∞? Yes (Ruzsa). In ℕ, the pointwise A - A uses truncated subtraction, but intersecting with [1,N] keeps exactly the positive differences, as intended. The ratio is taken in EReal, so N with an empty denominator do not break the limsup. Faithful.
